title: 5 Best Stocks to BUY in October
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: Seasonality setup then stock picks: September is historically the worst month (S&P 500 averaged -0.6% since 1945); this year September finished roughly flat for the S&P (+0.3%) and +2% for the Nasdaq while the Dow fell 4.3% and the Russell 2000 fell 5.3%. His earlier warning — don't panic when the market prices another Fed hike — resolved as he predicted: October rate-hike odds collapsed, and Q4 is 'the best quarter of the year', which he calls October the 'bear killer'. His five October buys: AVGO BUY ($500 12-month price target; AI infrastructure intact via networking and custom accelerators; analyst average $510, +40%; edge score 79), MELI BUY (pullback to forward PE 30.4x, PEG 0.6 on ~50% EPS growth — accumulate the world-class compounder; edge 82), UNH BUY (turnaround plus depressed valuation: forward PE 17.5x vs 5-year average 19.7x, FY EPS guide raised to $19.75, analyst average $475 (+25%); Q3 earnings Oct 13 is the test), UBER BUY (~$80 by year-end, DCF $82, analyst average $105; the market misunderstands autonomy — Uber can be both marketplace and fleet operator, a longer-term play with 35k Lucid robo-taxis committed), and LITE BUY (highest risk/reward of the five: the AI optical bottleneck — 1.6T modules, optical circuit switching — next-year EPS expected +150%, PEG under 1 at 58x forward PE; up 560% in 12 months so size lightly and expect volatility). No stance flips — AVGO moves from UNCERTAIN to BUY, the rest are reiterations or new coverage.

calls.base: Q revenue $29.6B (+86%), $13.7B FCF; DCF >10% above current price.
calls.bear: 10-yr Treasury at 5.3% and oil/geopolitics are the macro risks he flags.
